title: [LOGGED OUT] Sticky Store tab bar does not cover the "Loyalty shop" heading or highlight a wrong category
reason: The "Emeralds" tab is highlighted yellow while the Loyalty shop is shown; the ribbon top also sits slightly under the tab bar.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store and wait until loaded.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown at the bottom; clicked Dismiss.
Page scrolled to the Loyalty shop section.

steps.text: Wait 2 seconds until the page stops scrolling.
steps.saw: Waited; page stable (scrollY 14530). One scripted 2 s wait call hung for about 3 minutes, so the wait was longer than 2 s.

steps.text: Is the "Loyalty shop" heading ribbon fully visible (not covered by the Store tab bar)?
steps.saw: The heading text "Loyalty shop" is fully readable, but the ribbon's top edge touches/sits under the sticky tab bar: the ribbon block spans y=119 to 183 px while the tab bar ends at y=125 px (about 6 px overlap), and the ribbon top looks flat/clipped compared with the FAQ ribbon. May be a wording/strictness issue because only a few pixels are hidden; reviewer decides.

steps.text: Is no Store category tab (for example "Emeralds") highlighted in yellow while the Loyalty shop is shown?
steps.saw: The "Emeralds" tab at the right end of the tab bar is highlighted with a yellow pill while the Loyalty shop is shown.
